payload.recallText: There's a family who lived next door to the kennedy's for many years. They were both irish and catholic. Both families also incurred tragedies. A girl was crying in the back seat of a car when a song played that reminded her of the kennedy's and her dad told her to never be ashamed. They went to some sort of beach and there were four aunts there who weren't watching the kids. They got swept away in the riptide of the atlantic, but shortly got rescued on a speed boat. One of those rescuers was a kennedy. They safely made it back to knee deep water which they did not like at all.
